notes.title: Lareissa Everbright moving to Free to Play
notes.content:
Yes, you saw that right! The decision has been made to make Lareissa Everbright available to all users on Steam as a Free to Play title. It has been quite some time since Gwenaelle rode out into the world, and if you're reading this before the change has been made, I thank you for supporting the game thus far. 

The truth of the matter is, there has so far been a very small amount of people who have experienced Lareissa Everbright, and at the end of the day the desire for this project is to be played by as many people as possible. 

And so here we are. Lareissa Everbright will be left as a free to play game for the remainder of its lifetime on Steam, with the hope that players will stumble upon it and have a good old time playing through it.

notes.title: HOTFIX v1.0.1
notes.content:
Hey all,

Hotfix v1.0.1 is here to try and fix resolution issues that muck up the UI.

Changelog:

[list]
[*] The game will no longer default to the monitor's native resolution, and will instead be set to 1920x1080.
[/list]
